title: MapX architecture rules
description: Layers, selectors and the allow policy MapX checks the dependency graph against (.mapx/architecture.jsonc).

extends.description: Documents this one builds on: relative files and mapx:preset/<id>. Later documents override layers by name and merge rules.

parameters.description: Values for %name% in name, path and package selectors.

types.description: Edge types analysed. Default: import, require, extends, implements, call, instantiation, param_type, return_type.

inferred.description: How violations through inferred (heuristic) edges count. Default: warn.

inheritDependencies.description: A type answers for the dependencies of its workspace ancestors (through extends, implements and mixins, transitively): each is decided again with the type as source, and its finding names the inheritance path in via. A dependency the type has itself is not derived again. Default: false.

externals.description: Report dependencies on third-party elements in no layer. Default: true.

builtins.description: Report dependencies on standard-library elements in no layer. Default: false.

strictLayers.description: An element in several layers is an error, not a warning. Default: false.

internalTags.description: Doc tags that make a symbol internal to its layers: only its own layers may depend on it (rule internal-element). Compared like the docTag selector: case-insensitive, the @ optional. A member of an internal type, and a file whose top-level symbols are all internal, are internal too. Replaces the default: @internal, @mapx-internal.

nativeMarkers.description: Also treat each language's module-scoped visibility as an internal marker, for references the language itself refuses: Go internal/ (from outside its parent), Python _module (imported directly from outside its package; a re-export is public) and _name (from another module), Dart _name (another file) and lib/src/ (another package), Kotlin internal (another module), C# internal (another project without InternalsVisibleTo; partial types merged), Java package-private (another package), Rust pub(crate)/pub(self)/pub(super)/pub(in …) (outside the crate or module), and the TypeScript/JavaScript @internal tag (another package). Where the boundary is unknown, nothing is reported. PHP has none. Default: false.

rules.description: Source layer (or "*" for defaults every layer gets) → the layers it may depend on. Everything else between distinct layers is denied.

pointToGroups.description: Layer graphs (mapx arch graph): an edge into a layer named like its group points at the group.

codeclimate.description: CodeClimate (GitLab Code Quality) severity per finding: error and warn by the finding's severity, uncovered and skipped by its kind (mapx check --format codeclimate).

selectors.description: An element is in the layer when any selector matches it.

private.description: Elements reachable only from this layer.

overlay.description: Only ever a rule target (Deprecated, Vendor, …): never a source, never counted for coverage.

selector.description: Exactly one of the primary keys, plus the modifiers that refine it (kind for name, value for docTag, dev and direct for package, confidence for role).

name.description: Regex on the qualified name (case-insensitive unless /…/flags).

kind.description: With name: only these symbol kinds.

extends.description: A type with an ancestor of this name through extends hops only, transitively, workspace types and bases outside the index alike (Eloquent\Model, Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model, django.db.models.Model, sequelize#Model). The value is a name or its trailing namespace segments, case-insensitive, or /regex/flags on the ancestor's qualified name. A member of a type is judged by its type; never matches a file.

implements.description: A type with an ancestor of this name through a path with an implements hop: through an interface that extends it, or a superclass that implements it. Values as for extends. A member of a type is judged by its type; never matches a file.

inherits.description: A type with an ancestor of this name through any path of extends, implements and mixin hops. Values as for extends. A member of a type is judged by its type; never matches a file.

mixes.description: A type that mixes this in: a path whose last hop is a mixin (a PHP trait use, a Scala or Dart with), directly or through a base. Values as for extends. A member of a type is judged by its type; never matches a file.

inheritanceDepth.description: A type whose longest chain of bases is at least this long; a base outside the index counts as one level, and a cycle is cut. A member of a type is judged by its type; never matches a file.

decorator.description: A symbol carrying this decorator, attribute or annotation: the value equals its stored name (PHP: the fully qualified name, or the name as written) or is a suffix of it on a namespace boundary (\ or .), case-insensitively. Outside PHP, where names are stored as written, a qualified value also matches the stored name it ends in (System.Obsolete matches [Obsolete]). A leading @, \ or #[ is ignored, and in C# X and XAttribute match each other. /regex/flags is a regex on the stored name. Never matches a file.

docTag.description: A symbol whose doc block (PHPDoc, JSDoc/TSDoc, Javadoc/KDoc, C# XML doc, Python docstring) has this tag, e.g. @deprecated. The @ is optional and case is ignored; in Python a @deprecated decorator counts too. Never matches a file.

value.description: With docTag: one value of the tag matches this regex (case-insensitive unless written /…/flags).

member.description: A type with an own member (method, property, field, constant) whose name matches this regex, case-insensitive unless written /…/flags; a PHP property's $ is optional. Inherited members do not count. A member of a type is judged by its type; never matches a file.

package.description: An external element from a package matching this glob.

dev.description: With package: only dev (true) or only runtime (false) dependencies.

builtin.description: Standard library or runtime (true, or a name pattern).

ambient.description: Process-global state: env, globals (true, or a name pattern).

role.description: Its file has this MapX role.

confidence.description: With role: the classifier confidence at least this.

cluster.description: Its file is in this MapX cluster.

framework.description: A framework part, from the edges detectors store.

oneOf.description: "Layer", "+Layer" (also its allowances, transitively), "!Layer" (deny) or "*" (every non-overlay layer)
An allowance scoped to edge types or with its own severity; "allow" (a list) or "to" (one layer).

items.description: "Layer", "+Layer" (also its allowances, transitively), "!Layer" (deny) or "*" (every non-overlay layer)

to.description: "Layer", "+Layer" (also its allowances, transitively), "!Layer" (deny) or "*" (every non-overlay layer)
